title: Backport alias fallback fixes for Active Model to 8-1-stable
body:
### Motivation / Background

Ruby master branch (ruby 4.1.0dev) now warns when `alias` in a module falls back to `Object`, and the plan is to raise `NameError` in Ruby 4.3.

- https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22276
- https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18740

On `main`, #58817 alone was enough to fix Rails Nightly, because `main` had only one such alias left in Active Model. 8-1-stable still has two more, so backporting #58817 alone is not enough there. Rails Nightly on 8-1-stable (https://buildkite.com/rails/rails-nightly/builds/4748) fails with all three:

```
/rails/activemodel/lib/active_model/attribute_methods.rb:527: warning: the fallback to Object for alias of 'respond_to?' in module 'ActiveModel::AttributeMethods' is deprecated and will be removed in Ruby 4.3
/rails/activemodel/lib/active_model/validations.rb:439: warning: the fallback to Object for alias of 'send' in module 'ActiveModel::Validations' is deprecated and will be removed in Ruby 4.3
/rails/activemodel/lib/active_model/serialization.rb:167: warning: the fallback to Object for alias of 'send' in module 'ActiveModel::Serialization' is deprecated and will be removed in Ruby 4.3
```

### Detail

The three changes are bundled in one pull request rather than backported individually because they only make sense together in this context: removing the aliases that Ruby 4.1.0dev warns about. On their own, #56705 was a documentation fix and the `validations.rb` change has no upstream counterpart without the behavior change of #56130.

One commit per alias:

- `attribute_methods.rb`: cherry-pick of #58817, the same fix as `main`.
- `serialization.rb`: cherry-pick of #56705, which had already replaced `alias :read_attribute_for_serialization :send` with a method definition on `main`.
- `validations.rb`: replaces `alias :read_attribute_for_validation :send` with a method definition in the same way as #56705. On `main` this alias was removed by #56130, which also changed the method to return `nil` when the attribute cannot be read. That behavior change is not included here.

These changes also make `read_attribute_for_serialization` and `read_attribute_for_validation` appear in the 8.1 API documentation.

### Checklist

Before submitting the PR make sure the following are checked:

* [x] This Pull Request is related to one change. Unrelated changes should be opened in separate PRs.
* [x] Commit message has a detailed description of what changed and why. If this PR fixes a related issue include it in the commit message. Ex: `[Fix #issue-number]`
* [ ] Tests are added or updated if you fix a bug or add a feature.
* [ ] CHANGELOG files are updated for the changed libraries if there is a behavior change or additional feature. Minor bug fixes and documentation changes should not be included.
